title: Disentangling Forced and Internal Climate Variability in Single Realizations using Dynamic Mode Decomposition with Control
abstract: arXiv:2607.18298v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Separating externally forced trends from internal climate variability is a fundamental challenge in climate science, particularly when analyzing observational records that exist only as a single realization. We show that a single climate realization can be decomposed into forced and internal components by treating external forcing as a dynamical driver within a linear stochastic system, an idea grounded in pullback attractor theory. This addresses a central challenge for climate projection and for detecting and attributing the forced response. Existing single-realization methods rely on linear inverse models (LIMs), which ignore forcing, or linear regression, which omits dynamics. translated_title: 利用带控制的动态模态分解在单一实现中解耦强迫气候变率与内部气候变率
translated_abstract: 将外部强迫趋势与内部气候变率分离是气候科学中的一项根本性挑战，尤其是在分析仅以单一实现形式存在的观测记录时。我们证明，通过将外部强迫视为线性随机系统中的一个动力学驱动因子，可以将单一气候实现分解为强迫分量和内部分量，这一思想植根于拉回吸引子理论。这解决了气候预估以及强迫响应检测与归因中的一个核心难题。现有的单一实现方法依赖于忽略强迫作用的线性逆模型（LIM），或忽略动力过程的线性回归。在此，我们提出PullbackDMDc方法，该方法基于非自治动力系统理论和带控制的动态模态分解（DMDc），并结合拉回吸引子估计，将单一气候实现分解为空间模态……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出PullbackDMDc方法，基于非自治动力系统理论、带控制的动态模态分解与拉回吸引子估计，将外部强迫视为动力学驱动因子，从而实现从单一气候观测记录中分离强迫趋势与内部气候变率。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PullbackDMDc, a method grounded in non-autonomous dynamical systems theory, dynamic mode decomposition with control (DMDc), and pullback attractor estimation, which treats external forcing as a dynamical driver to disentangle forced trends from internal climate variability in single climate realizations.
